model_boundary.ordering: function-level CFG partial order plus block-local operation order
model_boundary.solidity: SolidityAtomicOperationExtractor produces sol_atom records; SoliditySemanticLifter only projects each atom to the common schema.
model_boundary.yul: S-SEIR alone analyzes Yul; YulSemanticLifter only projects completed S-SEIR results to the common schema.
model_boundary.bridge: SemanticFactBridge restores function-level CFG order and dependencies after both sources already share one schema.
